title: 5-bit conditional XOR / 2's-complement converter
problemDescription: Combinational dual-mode converter. se='1' → smo = si XOR (s broadcast across all bits) [s='1' inverts, s='0' passes through]. se='0' → smo = 2's complement of si, computed bit-by-bit: bit i = (NOT si(i)) XOR (AND of all NOT si(j<i)) with bit 0 forced to si(0).
